title: Triangle
summary: An 81.5-mile highway loop from Liberty Hill through Lampasas and Burnet, with a stop at the World’s Largest Spur.
body_markdown: Start at the US 183 and TX 29 crossing in Liberty Hill and head north on US 183 to Lampasas. Stop at the World’s Largest Spur for a shot of your bike, then follow US 281 south to Burnet and TX 29 east back to Liberty Hill.

sources.title: Google Maps itinerary reconstructed from the rider’s screenshot

author_note.text: I call this route Triangle. It follows highways, but I haven’t found them busy. A good route to put miles on the bike and enjoy a relaxed ride at highway speeds.

via: US 183 North -> US 281 South -> TX 29 East

stops.note: Take a shot of your bike with the world’s largest spur in the background.
